contract.d: on=0, 0.5cell=0.5h, 2cells=2h (h = default 1001-point cell at that vol, T=1), 1pct=log 1.01, 5pct=log 1.05

methods.R2: two-event increment reference: default-param V1 at the coincident booking + resolved gaps 1,2,4,8 d, fitted P0 + a g + b g^2; hw = max |quadratic - linear(1d)|, |quadratic - cubic|
methods.R1: V1 with grid_points raised to s/h >= 4.2 (or the finest feasible level); hw = refinement difference to the previous level; carries the default grid's own bias (R1_minus_R2)
methods.Fref: semi-analytic first step (Gaussian x exact event at spot x V1 continuation surface), grid 8001; hw = |Fref(8001) - Fref(4001)|
